title: Emberflow
tagline: Real-time collaborative editor with CRDT sync
description: A Notion-style block editor where every keystroke syncs across clients in under 80ms using a custom CRDT engine. Handles offline edits, conflict-free merges, and presence cursors for up to 40 concurrent editors per document.

title: Hoard
tagline: Self-hosted bookmark manager with full-text search
description: A privacy-first bookmark manager that indexes full page content locally using SQLite FTS5. Ships as a single binary, imports from every major browser, and includes a tagging system with saved smart-searches.

title: cli-forge
tagline: Zero-config scaffolding tool for CLI tools in Node
description: Generate a fully typed Node CLI with subcommands, auto-generated help text, and shell-completion scripts in under 10 seconds. Used by three open-source projects with a combined 40k weekly downloads.

title: Pixel Pantry
description: Tracks what's actually in your fridge and suggests recipes that use ingredients before they expire. Includes barcode scanning via device camera and a shareable weekly meal plan.

title: diffscope
tagline: Terminal UI for reviewing large git diffs
description: A fast, keyboard-driven TUI for reviewing pull requests without leaving the terminal. Syntax-highlights diffs, supports inline comments synced back to GitHub, and renders 10k-line diffs without lag.

title: Loopwatch
tagline: Visual regression testing for design systems
description: Captures component screenshots across breakpoints on every commit and flags visual diffs before they ship. Integrates with GitHub Actions and posts annotated diff images directly on pull requests.
